## RCA / CAPA (for bug fixes)
- [ ] Reproduced defect or documented why reproduction is unavailable
- [ ] Root cause supported by evidence; confidence stated
- [ ] Corrective action implemented
- [ ] Preventive action documented
- [ ] Regression test added

## Verification
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration / end-to-end tests (or justified not applicable)
- [ ] Lint / typecheck / build
- [ ] Security and authorization review
- [ ] Preview runtime smoke test
- [ ] Independent Master Auditor verdict: PASS

## Risk / release
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data in diff/logs
- [ ] Rollback plan documented
- [ ] No production migration/deployment without approval
- [ ] HITL approval obtained where required
